islands.name: Hatchling Hollow
islands.tagline: Eggs, nests and one very fussy mum

guardian.name: Mama Maia
phases: g:Shoo! Shoo! Nobody touches my shiny egg!
g:Still here? Oh, my poor nerves! Off you go, you little rascals!
g:Wait. Since when do eggs go tick-tock?
befriended: o:Mama Maia, it isn't an egg. It's the Cog from our time machine!
g:Oh my. Oh dear. I've been keeping a cog warm all week!
g:Here, take it, dears. And come back when my real babies hatch!

levels.title: Egg Hatch
intro: m:Look at all these eggs, Otter. They're about to hatch!
o:Answer the sums and they'll pop open!
m:Gently. They're only babies.
outro: o:Baby dinosaurs! They think I'm their mum.
m:You do have the right hair.

levels.title: Fern Dash
intro: g:HONK! Who's that sniffing round my nest?
o:Run, Mosey! Pick the path with the right answer!
m:Right answers make us faster. Go, go, go!
outro: o:We lost her! I think.
m:She's gone back to sit on something shiny.

levels.title: Stepping Stones
intro: m:This stream is too fast to swim, even for me.
o:Then we'll hop across on the stones with the right numbers!
m:Count carefully. Splashing is not a plan.
outro: o:Dry feet! Well, mostly.

levels.title: Tiptoe Past
intro: o:Shh! Mama Maia is fast asleep on her nest.
m:And look what she's sitting on. Our Cog!
o:Each right answer is one tiptoe closer. Quietly!
outro: m:She's sitting right on top of it.
o:Then we'll have to be brave. And quick.

levels.title: Mama Maia
intro: g:HONK! You again! Stay away from my shiny egg!
o:It's not an egg! It's part of our time machine!
m:Answer quickly, Otter. Here she comes!
outro: o:One part back. Five to go!
m:And not a single egg was harmed.
levels.blurb: Escape Mama Maia and win back the Cog

islands.name: Three-Horn Meadow
islands.tagline: Long grass and one grumpy triceratops

guardian.name: Trevor
phases: g:Hmph! Off my meadow! I'm far too busy being cross!
g:Boing! Boing! Every time I nod, this thing goes boing!
g:Three horns, and not one of them can reach it. Hmph!
befriended: o:Hold still, Trevor. One, two, three… pop! The Spring's off!
g:My horn! It's stopped boinging! Oh, that's much better.
g:Take your bouncy thing. And, er… thank you. Hmph.

levels.title: Long Grass Gallop
intro: g:Hmph! Who's rustling about in my meadow?
m:This grass is taller than me, and I'm quite tall.
o:It's Trevor! Run, Mosey, run!
outro: o:Phew! He's stopped to eat a fern.
m:And to grumble at it.

levels.title: Counting Stones
intro: o:A river! And the stepping stones count up in threes.
m:Three, six, nine… every stone is in the three times table.
o:Then hop, hop, hop!
outro: m:Three by three, all the way across.

levels.title: Meadow Nests
intro: m:Shh. More eggs, hidden in the long grass.
o:Triceratops eggs! Answer the sums to help them hatch.
m:Look, Otter. Their horns are tiny.
outro: o:Three little horns each!
m:Then let's count them in threes.

levels.title: Snoring Trevor
intro: o:Trevor's having a nap. Listen to him snore!
m:And there's our Spring, still stuck on his horn.
o:Tiptoe closer. Right answers only!
outro: o:I can't reach it without waking him.
m:Then we'll have to try when he's awake. Gulp.

levels.title: Trevor
intro: g:Hmph! You again! Leave me alone with my bad mood!
o:We can help you, Trevor! Hold still!
m:He's lowering his horns. Answer fast!
outro: o:Two parts back. Four to go!
m:And Trevor even gave us a smile.
levels.blurb: Escape Trevor and win back the Spring

islands.name: Spiky Swamp
islands.tagline: Muddy water and one spiky tail

guardian.name: Steggy
phases: g:Darlings, keep back! My tail has a mind of its own today!
g:Whirr! Whirr! It keeps spinning me round in circles!
g:Four spikes and one silly spinner. Somebody stop it!
befriended: m:Hold your tail still, Steggy. Otter, now!
g:Oh! It's stopped! I can walk in a straight line again!
g:Take your spinny thing, darlings. And do visit again!

levels.title: Swamp Swim
intro: m:Water! At last, something I'm good at.
o:Swim through the gaps with the right answers!
m:Hold on tight. Mosasaurs are very fast swimmers.
outro: o:That was brilliant, Mosey!
m:I'm a mosasaur. It's what we do.

levels.title: Lily Pad Hop
intro: o:Lily pads! Counting up in fours.
m:Four, eight, twelve… double the twos, then double again.
o:Hop on the right ones. The wrong ones sink!
outro: o:Four by four, and dry paws!

levels.title: Muddy Eggs
intro: m:Eggs, tucked in the warm mud.
o:Let's help them hatch!
m:Gently, Otter. No splashing.
outro: o:Look at their little back plates!
m:Tiny stegosauruses. Very spiky, very sweet.

levels.title: Sleepy Steggy
intro: o:Steggy's asleep in the reeds.
m:And the Propeller's spinning on her tail. Whirr, whirr.
o:Tiptoe closer. Don't wake her!
outro: m:Every time it spins, her tail twitches.
o:We need a plan. And a snack.

levels.title: Steggy
intro: g:Who's there? Careful, darlings, my tail is out of control!
o:We can stop it spinning, Steggy!
m:Duck, Otter! Here comes that tail!
outro: o:Three parts back. Halfway home!
m:And Steggy's walking in straight lines again.
levels.blurb: Escape Steggy and win back the Propeller

guardian.name: The Swoop Squad
phases: g:Ooh, shiny! Mine! No, mine! It's the Squad's!
g:Wait. It rings every hour and wakes us all up!
befriended: o:It's the Bell from our time machine. It rings every hour!
g:No wonder we've had no sleep! You have it, please!
g:And just so you know, we're pterosaurs, not dinosaurs!

levels.title: Cliff-Top Dash
intro: m:Something just swooped over my head.
g:Swoop! Swoop! Look at the funny furry one!
o:Pterodactyls! Run!
outro: g:We're pterosaurs, actually!
m:I know exactly how they feel.

levels.title: Ledge Leap
intro: o:Rocky ledges, counting up in eights.
m:Eight, sixteen, twenty-four. Double, double, double!
o:Don't look down!
outro: m:I looked down.
o:Me too. Let's never do that again.

levels.title: Cliff Nests
intro: m:A nest full of eggs, right on the edge.
o:Little pterosaurs! Let's help them hatch.
m:They'll be flying in no time.
outro: o:Look, they're flapping already!
m:And telling everyone they're not dinosaurs.

levels.title: Nest Peek
intro: o:The Swoop Squad is asleep in their nest.
m:And the Bell is right in the middle.
o:Tiptoe up. If it rings, they'll wake!
outro: n:Ding-a-ling! The Bell rang on the hour.
o:Uh-oh. They're awake!
levels.blurb: Creep up to the Squad's nest

levels.title: The Swoop Squad
intro: g:Hands off our shiny! Squad, swoop!
o:It's not yours! It's our time machine's Bell!
m:Here they come. Answer fast!
outro: o:Four parts back. Only two to go!
m:And a lot of very sleepy pterosaurs.
levels.blurb: Escape the Swoop Squad and win back the Bell

islands.name: Raptor Ridge
islands.tagline: Warm rocks and a clever pack

guardian.name: The Snatch Pack
phases: g:Keep-away! Keep-away! You can't catch us!
g:Throw it to me! No, me! Over here!
g:Hey, why does it go up to twelve? We can only count to three!
befriended: o:It's our Dial. It counts all the way to twelve. Want to learn?
g:Yes! Teach us! Sharing is more fun than keep-away!
g:Here's your Dial. Can we count to twelve together?

levels.title: Ridge Run
intro: m:Why is that bush clucking?
g:Snatch Pack, go! Go! Go!
o:Raptors! They're like angry chickens! Run!
outro: o:They're fast. But we're faster.
m:Only because you know your sharing facts.

levels.title: Warm Rock Eggs
intro: m:Eggs on a warm rock, all cosy.
o:Share out the numbers to hatch them!
m:Fluffy baby raptors. Oh dear.
outro: o:They're chirping at me!
m:I think they want your snack.

levels.title: Hot Rock Hop
intro: o:Warm rocks, all in a row!
m:Hop on the right numbers and we'll get across.
o:Toasty toes!
outro: o:Toasty, but safe!
m:Next time, let's find a bridge.

levels.title: Raptor Nap
intro: o:Shh. The Snatch Pack is having a nap.
m:The Dial is tucked under the biggest one's chin.
o:Tiptoe closer. Don't step on a feather!
outro: m:One of them's opening an eye.
o:Time to go!

levels.title: The Snatch Pack
intro: g:Keep-away! You'll never get it back!
o:We will, if we share it out right!
m:Here they come. Quick sums, Otter!
outro: o:Five parts back! Just one to go.
m:And I know exactly who has it.
levels.blurb: Escape the Snatch Pack and win back the Dial

islands.name: T-Rex Territory
islands.tagline: The biggest, loudest dinosaur of all

guardian.name: Rex
phases: g:ROAR! Everybody run! I'm in a very bad mood!
g:ROAR! It ticks and it tocks and it itches!
g:My arms are too short! I can't reach the itch! ROAR!
befriended: o:Rex, the itch is our Times Core! Bend down, and I'll climb up!
g:Oh. Oh! That's the spot! A little to the left! Aaah!
g:Best scratch ever. Here, take your ticking thing. Friends?

levels.title: Tiptoe Past Rex
intro: m:Otter. Look at the size of those footprints.
o:And listen to the size of that snore. It's Rex!
m:Tiptoe past. Very, very quietly.
outro: o:The Times Core is stuck on his back!
m:No wonder he's grumpy. It's ticking right between his shoulders.

levels.title: Giant Eggs
intro: m:These eggs are enormous!
o:Baby T-Rexes! Answer the sums to hatch them.
m:I hope they're friendlier than their dad.
outro: o:They're adorable! Look at their tiny arms!
m:Everything here has tiny arms. I have flippers.

levels.title: Footprint Hop
intro: o:Giant footprints, full of muddy water.
m:Hop across on the right numbers.
o:Rex must be enormous.
outro: m:He is. And he's coming this way.

levels.title: The Big Stomp
intro: g:ROAR! Who's been hatching my babies?
o:Run, Mosey! Fastest answers ever!
m:I'm a mosasaur! I'm not built for running!
outro: o:We made it to the volcano!
m:One part left. And it's on his back.

levels.title: Rex
intro: g:ROAR! You can't hide from me forever!
o:We don't want to hide. We want to help!
m:Here he comes! Every right answer counts!
outro: o:Six parts! The Times Machine is complete!
m:We can go home, Otter. But let's say goodbye first.
levels.blurb: Escape Rex and win back the Times Core

intro: n:One sunny morning on Rainbow Island…
o:Ta-da! Mosey, meet the Tick-Tock Times Machine!
m:Otter, it's a bathtub.
o:A bathtub that travels through time! It runs on times tables.
m:Could it take us back to the dinosaurs? Mosasaurs swam in the sea back then.
o:Your great-great-great… great-grandma! Answer three sums to wind it up!
introAfter: n:Whoosh! Back, back, back… sixty-six million years!
n:CLANG! The Times Machine crash-landed and burst into six pieces!
m:Otter, the parts flew off in every direction.
o:No parts, no machine. No machine, no way home!
n:Then, not very far away, something very big went ROAR.
m:Because it's a lot closer now.
askGrownUp: o:Hey, don't worry! Why don't you ask a grown-up for some help?
m:This one's a bit tricky. How about asking a grown-up to help us?
o:You're trying really hard! Shall we get a grown-up to help with this one?
m:Even the best explorers ask for help. Why don't you find a grown-up?

intro: o:Back to Crash Camp! Time to fit the part.
m:Every bolt has to go in just the right place. Let's count carefully.
done: o:It fits! Listen to it tick!

intro: o:Campfire sing-along! We sing, you sing with us, and you can stomp along on the drum.
m:We'll sing it three times. A little faster every time!
warmUp: m:Before we explore, let's learn a times-table song. It'll help us later!
round2: o:Your turn! We sing the start, and you sing the answer.
round3: m:Rex speed! Sing the whole line with us, super fast!
quiz: o:Now let's fill the ladder! Type each answer, in order.
m:Take your time. The band will wait for you.
shuffle: m:Now the tricky bit. The same times table, all mixed up!
done: m:That's another times table you know by heart.

opening: n:The six parts are back where they belong…
n:The Times Machine is whole again!
n:Every dinosaur came to say goodbye!

guardians.hollow: g:Goodbye, my dears! Come back when my babies hatch!
guardians.meadow: g:Hmph. I'll miss you. A tiny bit. Don't tell anyone.
guardians.swamp: g:Goodbye, darlings! Look, I can walk in a straight line!
guardians.ridge: g:One, two, three… all the way to twelve! Bye!
guardians.rex: g:Thank you, little friends. Best scratch ever.

thanks: o:We couldn't have done any of this without you!
m:All those times tables, and you never gave up!
o:Three cheers for our champion! Hip hip…
photo: m:Everyone squeeze in for a photo! Say cheese!
after: o:Every zone's open now, so you can play any level again, whenever you like!
m:And there are still trophies hiding out there, and stars to win, and pets to find!
